optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Conversational AI Engineer, Support Chat Assistant

professionalSummary.text: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models using held-out replay sets and annotated conversation corpora, with a focus on deflection metrics and model limitations.
professionalSummary.witness: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.

professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained an offline evaluation harness that measured intent accuracy, retrieval recall, and replay-set regressions for candidate models prior to release.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.

professionalSummary.text: Documented model limitations and hand-over conditions in model cards and release notes, including training data cuts, replay-set results, and failure modes on multi-intent messages.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which managed the release pipeline, live dashboards, and on-call rota; my involvement concluded at release review without access to live conversation data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which held the release pipeline, the live dashboards and the on-call rota; my involvement ended at the release review, and I did not have access to the live conversation data.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored deflection and hand-off rates through offline evaluation metrics, including replay-set regressions, but did not directly observe live traffic metrics.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Evaluation harness reports for three release candidates with sandbox experiment identifiers and model card for the intent classifier.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the evaluation harness report for the last three release candidates with sandbox experiment identifiers, and the model card for the intent classifier.

skills.text: Model training and evaluation for intent classification and answer retrieval systems.
skills.witness: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.

skills.text: Model card and release note documentation for production model transparency.
skills.witness: Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on model training, evaluation, documentation, and release candidate preparation in a sandbox environment, but do not establish direct experience with live traffic metrics, on-call incident handling, or coordination with the platform team beyond release review.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has partial evidence for requirements but lacks direct evidence of live traffic monitoring, on-call incident handling, and full coordination with platform team beyond release review.
